newsitem.title: USA: Keyport Life Insurance names Koch as new CFO.
newsitem.headline: Keyport Life Insurance names Koch as new CFO.

text.p: Keyport Life Insurance Co said on Monday that it had appointed Bernhard Koch as senior vice president and chief financial officer of the company, succeeding Paul LeFevre, who will fill the new position of executive vice president of strategic planning and marketing.
Koch, 42, joins Keyport from Life Partners Group Inc, where he served as executive vice president and chief financial officer, Keyport said in a statement.
LeFevre, 55, served as chief financial officer of Keyport since 1991, the life insurance company added.
